The elliptical shape of the burner grate in the background seems slightly inconsistent with the perspective of the pan rim, suggesting minor geometric warping in the background generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a frying pan and distinguish it from other cookware like woks or sauté pans based on visual features.
To analyze the realism of the hash brown texture and the cast iron seasoning, checking for smearing or unnatural patterns.
To verify the spatial relationship between the pan and the burner grate, ensuring the pan sits correctly on the stove without floating or clipping.
